title: 第五章：被抓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏行枫在唐明军的带领下，来到一家私房菜馆。两个人要了一间小包间，点了好些菜，苏行枫让他少点点，可是这家伙就是说今天高兴要吃就吃好的，一会还有自己的老子也要来，说是要当面感谢他呢！

苏行枫听到后吓了一跳，这个什么情况？不就是一些木料吗？不至于这么隆重吧！

“我说明军啊！这会不会不太好啊？你老子也要来，这我可受不起啊！”

两个人在一起聊天的很热呼，现在苏行枫也熟络起唐明军来。

“什么叫隆重？我没把红地毯给你铺上就不叫隆重，多的好话我也不会说，等一下我那老子来了你才知道什么叫隆重，你就安心等着吧！”

他们两在那包间坐了好一会儿，聊着天。这还没过二十分钟时间门外就传来敲门声，唐明军起身去把门面还跟着一个年青的成功人士青年，他们三走在一起还真有这么有点像。

“爸，哥，这位就是我说的苏行枫，就是他给我们提供的木料”

“行枫，这位是我爸唐豪诚，这位是我哥，唐明涛”

唐明军站在中间给大家介绍了一下。

“伯父，明涛哥，你们好，你们叫我行枫就可以了”

“好啊！行枫今天真是要好好感谢你啊！哈哈”

“这不是明军谢过了嘛！哪还要您老人家亲自跑一趟呢！”

“这话可不能这么说，你可知道？就因为你这些木料，可以说救了我们家的产业啊！这小子也只能说他命好，让他命中有这有一朝，能遇到你这位贵人啊！”

唐豪诚转头了了一眼自己的小儿子，然后拉着苏行枫坐在桌前，还一个劲的要拉着他坐在自己身边，完全是那种把最大的功臣忘在一边的感觉，把唐明军放在一边不理。

现在他总算是知道唐明军的性格是怎么来的了，可以说这一切都是遗传啊！他家老子那豪放的性格，能说会道的，可以说上知天文下知地理啊！在喝了几杯后越说是越离谱了，再要不把闸门关了这是要把月亮给哄下来了啊！

他哥哥唐明涛还算靠谱，说什么都是有根有据的，不会瞎说。一家人就这么你一言我一语的和苏行枫聊着，生活，事业，过去，未来。就这么一餐晚饭时间他和他们一家人在感情上可以说增进了不少，毕竟人家真心的是把你当恩人待呢！

双方都聊了一些家常，以唐豪诚为主，公司总裁，唐明涛总经理，而到了唐明军这就是分公司一个部门经理。他家还有一个母亲，可惜常年卧病在床，今天就没有来，可以说一家四口生活的还可以，就是现在公司里遇到了难处，好在的是现在全在这饭桌上全给解决了。

“行枫啊，今晚要不就到家里休息一晚吧？这离你那住的地方有一段路呢！”

吃完后唐豪诚邀请他去自己家做客呢！

“伯父，我就不麻烦你们了，你们就先回去吧！我自己走走路，散散酒气没事的。”

“是啊爸，行枫怎么说都是当过兵的人，一个大男人怕什么啊，要不我陪行枫走走，然后我打的回家吧！”

“你就想想就可以了，我还不知道你心里点小九九是吧？给我滚上车去”

唐明军本就是借着苏行枫的名义想逃离自家老子的，可哪想他老人家一看就知道。

“伯父，真不用管我，你们早点回去休息吧”

“那好吧，路上注意安全”

说完他就押着唐明军上了车，然后唐明涛笑着对苏行枫点点头也上了车。

从下午六点钟到现在十一点，这也太能整了吧？和他们一家告别之后，自己就一个人在街上慢慢的走着，欣赏着苏市的夜景，看着十月份那些还穿着裙装的美女们。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Su Xingfeng, led by Tang Mingjun, came to a private restaurant.The two of them asked for a small private room and ordered a lot of dishes. Su Xingfeng asked him to order less, but this guy just said that he would eat as much as he wanted today, and his father would also come later, saying that he wanted to thank him in person!

Su Xingfeng was shocked when he heard this. What is going on?Isn't it just some wood?It shouldn't be so grand!

"I'm Mingjun! Isn't this bad? Your father is coming too, and I can't bear this!"

The two of them chatted lively together, and now Su Xingfeng also became familiar with Tang Mingjun.

"What does grandness mean? If I don't lay out the red carpet for you, it's not grandness. I won't say many nice things. You won't know what grandness means until my old man comes here. You can just wait and see!"

The two of them sat in the private room for a long time, chatting.Not even twenty minutes had passed before there was a knock on the door. Tang Mingjun got up and went to open the door, followed by a young successful man. The three of them looked alike when they walked together.

"Dad, brother, this is the Su Xingfeng I'm talking about, it's the wood he provided us."

"Xing Feng, this is my father, Tang Haocheng, and this is my brother, Tang Mingtao."

Tang Mingjun stood in the middle and introduced everyone.

"Uncle, Brother Mingtao, hello, you can just call me Xingfeng."

"Okay! Xing Feng really wants to thank you today! Haha"

"Didn't the Ming army thank you? Why do you need to go there in person!"

"You can't say this, do you know? Just because of your timber, it can be said that our family's industry has been saved! This boy can only say that he has a good life, and that he is destined to meet this noble person like you one day!"

Tang Haocheng turned his head and glanced at his youngest son, then pulled Su Xingfeng to sit at the table, and insisted on pulling him to sit next to him. It felt like he had forgotten his biggest hero, and ignored Tang Mingjun.

Now he finally knows how Tang Mingjun's character came about. It can be said that it is all genetic!His father has a bold character, is eloquent, and can be said to know everything from astronomy to geography!After drinking a few drinks, the words became more and more outrageous. If the floodgates were not closed, the moon would be coaxed down!

His brother Tang Mingtao is quite reliable. Everything he says is well-founded and he doesn't talk nonsense.The family just chatted with Su Xingfeng about life, career, past and future.It can be said that the relationship between him and their family has improved a lot during such a dinner. After all, they really treat you as a benefactor!

Both parties chatted about some common matters, mainly Tang Haocheng, the company's president, Tang Mingtao, general manager, and Tang Mingjun, a department manager of the branch.There is also a mother in his family, but unfortunately she has been bedridden all year round and did not come today. It can be said that the life of the family of four is not bad, but they are encountering difficulties in the company. Fortunately, they are all solved at this dinner table.

"Xing Feng, why don't you go home and rest for the night? This is quite a way from where you live!"

After eating, Tang Haocheng invited him to his home as a guest!

"Uncle, I won't bother you anymore. Just go back first! I'll walk by myself and let go of the drunkenness. It'll be fine."

"Yes, Dad, Xing Feng is a soldier after all. What should a grown man be afraid of? How about I accompany Xing Feng for a walk, and then I can take him home!"

"Just think about it. I don't know what you are thinking about Xiao Jiujiu, right? Get in the car."

Tang Mingjun originally wanted to escape from his father in the name of Su Xingfeng, but he knew it at a glance.

"Uncle, you really don't have to worry about me. You can go back and rest early."

"Well, be careful on the road."

After saying that, he escorted Tang Mingjun into the car, and then Tang Mingtao smiled and nodded to Su Xingfeng and got into the car.

From six o'clock in the afternoon to now eleven o'clock, this is too easy, right?After saying goodbye to their family, I walked slowly on the street alone, admiring the night view of Sioux City and looking at the beauties still wearing dresses in October.
